series.name: Dial 10
series.derivation: hues of the dial (coral 22°, yellow 82°, mint 165°, sky 225°) + pin (263°) with blended hues between them; two chroma variants share one ink tier
series.rule: A5.2 — categorical fills are luminous (L .66–.84, the lightness contour of the dial itself) and are separated by ≥1px --border-default edges or an ink outline; fills need not reach 3:1 against canvas. Text, lines and marks thinner than 3px use the ink tier (≥4.5:1). Legend swatches always carry a hairline border. Colour-only identification stops at slot 6; slots 7–10 carry shape cues. Bind by category ID, never by position.
